title: French Quiche with Mushroom and Zesty Herbs
description: A savory French quiche filled with sautéed mushrooms and infused with zesty herbs, perfect for a weekend brunch or dinner.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place it in a tart pan.
Sauté the mushrooms in butter until tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and grated cheese.
Add the zesty herbs and season with salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture into the pie crust.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the quiche is set.
Let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
